scope: Post-open deterministic-reference qualification on the already opened BLASTNet Case 5 virtual-nine roster. This experiment adds the previously unread globally fixed geometry-Jacobi PCGLS depths K9 through K15, retains K8 and K16 as sealed continuity sentinels, and performs no learned prediction, external generalization, resource benchmark, curved-ray validation, or real-BOST evaluation.
scientific_question: What is the lowest single global geometry-Jacobi PCGLS depth in K9 through K16 that preserves every frozen absolute gate and every frozen matched-accuracy gate against the independently adequate K16 reference over all 546 cells and all 13 complete rigs?

unread_before_freeze: all K9 through K15 physical fields and metrics
all K9 through K15 matched ratios against K16
the lowest globally adequate and K16-matched depth

opened_scope.dataset: BLASTNet vitiated H2-air freely propagating flame DNS Case 5
opened_scope.role: already opened post-open deterministic-reference development data only

solver_contract.solver: Unmodified strict PCGLS recurrence with zero initialization, denominator floor 1e-30, and the v215 exact geometry-only Jacobi preconditioner.
solver_contract.preconditioner: Exact diag(A^T A), relative floor 1e-6, median-positive normalization, fixed by reported geometry before observation and truth metrics.
solver_contract.selection_rule: Select the first depth in the fixed global order K9 through K16 that passes every absolute and K16-matched gate over all 546 cells and all 13 complete rigs. The same selected depth applies to every cell, frame, and rig; per-cell, per-frame, or per-rig depth selection is forbidden.
solver_contract.parent_continuity: The newly replayed K8 and K16 fields, metrics, observations, and logical call ledgers must match the sealed v215 geometry-Jacobi PCGLS arms within the frozen tolerances.

matched_accuracy_ratios.denominator: The corresponding replayed geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K16 metric, with a fixed 1e-30 numerical floor only to reject division by zero.

execution_and_cost_contract.single_checkpoint_trajectory_per_cell: One unchanged PCGLS trajectory runs through K16 and records K8 through K16; candidates are not rerun separately.
execution_and_cost_contract.geometry_setup_disclosure: Exact geometry-Jacobi setup wall and state bytes remain separate from logical online A/A^T. No setup amortization, wall, RSS, or deployment claim is authorized.
execution_and_cost_contract.camera_permutation_sentinels: For frame 0 of each of the 13 rigs, reverse the active camera order and restore observation blocks by camera ID; the inverse diagonal, K16 field, metrics, and selection-relevant quantities must remain invariant within tolerance.

independent_validation.implementation: A second program must not import the v217 formal runner. It must independently parse all 42 raw density fields, rebuild all 13 virtual-nine rigs and exact observations, independently build the exact geometry-Jacobi preconditioner, implement PCGLS, recompute K8 through K16 physical fields and four metrics, all absolute and K16-matched gates, the globally selected depth, camera-permutation sentinels, actual A/A^T ledgers, parent continuity, input seals, and the final decision.

decision_order: Any source or input mismatch, unexpected parent status, wrong shape or depth order, non-finite value, parent-continuity failure, call-ledger mismatch, permutation failure, K16 inadequacy, formal-independent drift beyond tolerance, or decision mismatch gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_GLOBAL_PCGLS_DEPTH_QUALIFICATION_V217.
Select the first globally fixed K9-through-K16 depth that passes every absolute and K16-matched gate.
If K9 through K15 all fail and K16 passes, conclude PASS_K16_REMAINS_MINIMAL_ADEQUATE_GLOBAL_PCGLS_DEPTH_V217.
If one of K9 through K15 passes first, conclude PASS_LOWER_GLOBAL_PCGLS_DEPTH_QUALIFIED_V217 and record that unique lowest depth and its logical exact-call reduction relative to K16.
No result authorizes a learned warm start, wall/RSS claim, external generalization, curved-ray claim, or real-BOST claim.

stop_rules.on_k16_minimal: Keep K16 as the adequate deterministic reference. Any future warm initializer must match K16 and strictly reduce both A and A^T; do not weaken the reference or use per-cell depth selection.
stop_rules.on_lower_depth: Freeze the selected lower global depth as the sole deterministic reference for the next initializer gate. Do not choose a deeper or shallower reference after seeing initializer results.
stop_rules.on_inconclusive: Preserve all evidence and fix only the explicit validity defect; do not interpret partial depth values.
stop_rules.always: Do not rescue a failed mechanism with a larger neural model or GPU.
